What We Coat for Burlington Businesses

We coat steel, aluminum and stainless parts for local businesses, from steel fabrications and aluminum parts to trailer components, outdoor equipment and brackets. Parts range from small hardware to large frames within our 6,000 lb capacity, finished in matte, satin, gloss or textured powder.

Local customers send everything from one-off repairs to full production batches, so each order starts with the metal, the size and the finish. Pretreatment and masking are planned before coating, and powder coating for Burlington businesses always follows a written plan. Typical parts include:

blocks.text: Colour choices for Burlington powder coating range from RAL matches to simple black and grey, and we record every code so reorders match. Our approach to powder coating Burlington orders is built on records. Every job gets a work order that notes the metal, the colour code, the finish and any bare surfaces, so later runs match the first and batch consistency holds. Large parts fit our oversized oven, and our [capabilities page](/capabilities) lists current size and weight limits so you can check a part before you travel.

Burlington powder coating is checked after curing, not assumed. Parts are sprayed with polyester powder by electrostatic spray and cured in the oven at roughly 180–200 °C. Film thickness is measured following ASTM D7091, adhesion can be tested to ASTM D3359, and test reports are available on request. Our quality steps are documented with the Absolute Bureau of Certification, so your own customer can ask for proof.
